scope: Remote-wrapper Git identities checked in controller, followed by native wrapper/decompressed-envelope/member bytes and metadata verification only. No product or original receiver rerun.

controller_remote_wrapper_validation.algorithm: SHA-1 over exact ASCII Git blob header+full fetched body

transport_history.scope: Transport only; native builds/browser qualification and sealed envelopes are unchanged.

attempts.note: Create returned ReadTimeout; no success pin claimed and no retry. Exact native payload is preserved inside syntax-review packet.
ReadTimeout followed by404 at exact expected blob; no inference that asynchronous original can never appear. No original mutation repeated.

transport_history.resolution: Deterministic gzip+Base64 transport wrappers bound to full unchanged native envelope bytes/SHA256/Git, with decompression roundtrip verified on host.

limits: This is byte custody, not new application qualification.
The driver uses admitted native paths and is not a portable general extraction tool.
Remote Git identity and native full identity jointly bind exact wrapper bytes; decompressed native envelopes are compared directly.
No recorded original_path is written or extracted.
Previous Python failure, original semantic negatives and transport timeout history are preserved.
